ios.desc:
Upload a recorded video or capture training footage in real time and submit to our secure cloud. SportsTrace takes over from there, analyzing your video to determine how your body moves in three dimensions. You give us video, we give you advanced insights about your body and personalized recommendations designed to help you improve. Compare your movements over time and track your progress as SportsTrace helps you improve your technique.

With SportsTrace you get:
- Upload video in real time or from your gallery
- Video and training session management
- Playback anytime, anywhere
- 3D biomechanical analysis
- Automatic telestration overlays
- AI personalized recommendations
- Compare two videos side-by-side
- Compare Overlay
- Library of professional videos
- Unlimited cloud storage
- Team data and reports
- Performance dashboards
- Athlete video management for in facility or remote training
- SportsTrace customer support

With SportsTrace you can manage, review, recommend and compare all of your training video to help you achieve your athletic potential.

Train smarter with SportsTrace.

quotes.text:
Hi! SportsTrace turns game and practice video of athletes into ways for those athletes to improve at their sport. We used to make this with fancy cameras but this year we released a mobile app for our service and platform that works with your cellphone camera. We're former Microsoft, former athletes/coaches.

You DO need an account (I know this is not ideal). You can download in the app store of your choice and then sign up.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mf.sportstrace

https://apps.apple.com/app/id1543240986
